text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ayaya... My legs are still swollen stiff.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um... I found these stylish shoes 
yesterday and bought them on impulse, but—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not used to walking in high heels, so 
I'm completely exhausted."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Maybe these boots really are too much for 
me to handle... Ugh~, I gotta break 'em in 
before training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking exhausted, Yukino Bijin massaged 
her legs.
